CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 21
   D. 9

2. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 5

3. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 12

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 144

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 81

6. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 73
   C. 17
   D. 1

7. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

8. Solve for x: x + 4 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 4

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 17
   D. 15

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 122

11. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

12. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 24

13. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 1, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

14. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 15
   C. 57
   D. 56

15. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 12
   C. 7
   D. 13

16. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 36

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
